title: Platform-specific usage: FileMaker Server
description: Scripts in scope that demonstrably run server-side: targets of Perform Script on Server callsites (steps 164/210), resolved via the calls_script edges with Link_Subrole on_server/on_server_callback (schema 1.20.0 — declared cross-file targets resolve through the P4 resolution ladder). Derivation: 'built for Server' = 'is called via PSoS' — context evidence, stated per finding; Claris publishes no server-exclusive steps or functions. Targets outside the imported catalog appear as explicit unresolved rows; by-name callsites (target computed at runtime) as explicit dynamic rows. Inventory, not defects — findings are neutral properties, never errors. The dashboard view is the server usage profile of the solution: binding KPIs (targets by resolution kind), the caller-to-target callsite drill-down, and the plug-in functions whose server support is conditional on the server operating system (available on the server, but not for every server OS - relevant for Linux-based deployments; needs the plug-in platform map).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A script called via Perform Script on Server executes server-side — execution context is the only binding signal that exists for FileMaker Server (there are no server-exclusive steps or functions). The finding says 'built for Server', not 'uses server features'.
rule.remediation: Nothing to fix. Use the inventory to identify the server-batch layer of the solution; run the FileMaker Server compatibility aspect to check the same scripts for steps that fail server-side.
